title: Token telemetry rewrite: streaming gateway for per-route cost attribution
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Background: Our current nightly batch reconciliation produces late and sometimes divergent per-route cost numbers that drive the Console cost breakdowns and automated chargeback jobs. Problem: teams see spikes in "unexpected" usage and credits are applied retroactively, causing customer support noise and difficulties for Dedicated capacity planning. Goal: Replace the current monolithic batch aggregator with a lightweight streaming gateway that emits canonical per-request token events (ingestable by the metrics pipeline) and a compact per-route delta ledger for downstream attribution jobs. The rewrite should preserve existing semantics for legacy consumers while enabling near-real-time cost visibility and faster anomaly detection.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming gateway deployed behind feature flag and ingesting traffic from runtime and router proxies
Per-request token event schema v2 documented and compatible with existing downstream join keys
End-to-end latency for token visibility <= 90s for 95th percentile in test cluster
No loss of accounting fidelity: nightly reconciler run shows <0.25% divergence vs baseline for a 72-hour window
Console cost dashboard (per-route & per-model) updated to consume streaming deltas and shows consistent numbers with ledger
Automated fallback: if gateway unavailable, system falls back to compact batched snapshots without double-counting
notes: 2026-02-11: Kickoff meeting with Console PM and Observability. PM (María Ortega) emphasized SLAs for 99th percentile latency on Dedicated customers.
2026-02-13: Chose protobuf-over-kafka for the event wire format to reduce message size and enforce schema evolution rules (see PR #4123).
2026-02-17: Prototype shows ~30% lower tail latency vs current batch-forwarder under mixed small/long-stream load.
2026-02-19: Design decision: gateway will emit both 'request_token' (per-request) and 'route_delta' (compact aggregation) records to support low-cost long-term storage.
2026-02-22: Eng review feedback from SRE (Tomás Nguyen): add a circuit-breaker and a local ack buffer to avoid head-of-line blocking during KAFKA spikes.
2026-02-24: Security review scheduled; KMS envelope for any persisted intermediate snapshots required (ticket ENG-21800 placeholder).
Testing: added 3 integration load tests simulating multi-tenant Dedicated bursts (scripts in infra/testbench/load/token_gateway_test.sh)

Trade-offs considered: option to embed attribution at ingestion (edge) would reduce downstream joins but increase coupling and make model-version rollbacks harder. Decided to keep attribution in gateway but emit minimal deltas so downstream can rehydrate historical ledgers.
Follow-ups: schedule a canary run for one high-volume tenant after metrics ingestion validations (owner: Derek Liu).
PR Comments: Need explicit schema version in each message to support cross-cluster rolling upgrade.
Rollback plan: disable gateway feature flag and let downstream consumers switch back to nightly snapshot ingestion within 10 minutes.
